messages:
Maya (Docs): FYI I'm opening a docs PR to retire the legacy audit field `event_type_v1` and standardize on `event_category` + `event_action`. Need to sync SDK snippets + SOC2-friendly retention wording. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/1125
Liam (Eng): Thanks — can you add a short migration script example? ops will want a one-liner to rewrite exports. Also flag any runtime compatibility issues.
Maya (Docs): Yep, adding a migration appendix and JSONL example. Will include a sample jq command and a small node script. Also updating the REST example in the API guide.
Sophia (Security): Quick note on wording: for SOC2 we should avoid phrasing like "we delete after X" without scope. Prefer: "records are retained for a configurable retention period (default 90 days) unless otherwise required by law." That keeps it accurate and audit-safe.
Alex (SDK): For SDKs: we need to update snippets in js/go/ruby. For streaming audit export the field rename touches parser logic; I'll add a compatibility shim for one release: map `event_type_v1` -> `event_category` if present. Will open SDK PRs after your docs text lands.
doc-bot: PR opened by Maya (Docs): https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/1125 — reviewers requested: @Liam, @Alex (SDK)
Liam (Eng): Migration jq one-liner suggestion: ```jq '.event_category = (.event_type_v1 // .event_category) | del(.event_type_v1)' input.jsonl > output.jsonl``` — simple, non-destructive. Add that to the appendix.
Maya (Docs): Nice — I'll include that and a small Node example for teams that want streaming rewrites. Also adding a brief note in "Exporting audit logs" about preserving tenant IDs and PII redaction guidance.
Sophia (Security): Add acceptance criteria for the docs change: 1) wording aligns with SOC2 language above, 2) code snippets show both old->new mapping, 3) link to legal-approved retention policy page, 4) mention that exports are exported encrypted at rest.
Alex (SDK): I'll make three SDK PRs: js#881, go#442, ruby#123. Plan: add compatibility shim for 2 minor releases, deprecation warning at runtime, and update examples to use `event_category` by default.
Maya (Docs): Can folks review the PR text for the SOC2 phrasing? Specifically the retention sentence: "Records are retained for a configurable retention period (default: 90 days) and can be extended per customer agreement."
Sophia (Security): Slight tweak: "Records are retained for a configurable retention period (default 90 days) and may be retained longer where required by law or customer agreement." That covers legal exceptions.
Liam (Eng): Also add a short tech note about index rebuild implications when field name changes — some customers may need to re-index their export consumers.
Maya (Docs): Good call. I'll add a "breaking-change" note and recommend the jq migration command and the Node streaming snippet.
Alex (SDK): ETA for SDK PRs is EOD tomorrow. I'll include test vectors and mention the deprecation header in logs: `X-Audit-Deprecation: event_type_v1` so integrators see warnings.
Maya (Docs): Final checklist for merge: [ ] update api examples in REST guide, [ ] add jq and node migration snippets, [ ] add SOC2 phrasing per Sophia, [ ] link to legal retention policy, [ ] cross-link SDK PRs and add note about compatibility shim.
Sophia (Security): Once docs text is settled ping me and I'll run legal-approved phrasing through compliance one last time.
Liam (Eng): I'll review the docs PR and the migration appendix. If we can land SDK shims within the same release window it minimizes customer confusion.
Maya (Docs): Plan: docs PR will be ready for review in ~2 hours, aiming to merge by Fri COB. If anything blocks, call it out here. Thanks everyone :thumbsup:
